name: Caravaggio
findings: Uses smoky black 3.3x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 860 paintings here).
Uses black 3.0x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 860 paintings here).
Uses raisin black 2.5x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 860 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, ochre yellow turns up as a small accent in 80% of the paintings that hold it, 2.6x the archive's rate (from 860 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, brown turns up as the lightest note in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 4.1x the archive's rate (from 860 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, burgundy turns up as the shadow in 86% of the paintings that hold it, 2.8x the archive's rate (from 860 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 860 paintings here).
Pairs burgundy with purple red more than chance would predict (3 of 860 paintings here).
